cards.text: Paul, an apostle, is writing to the church in Corinth. He's just told them, "Our hearts are open wide," and asked them to open theirs too (2 Corinthians 6:11-13). Now he gives them a command: "Do not be unequally yoked with unbelievers."

cards.question: Paul backs up his command with questions: "For what partnership can righteousness have with wickedness? Or what fellowship does light have with darkness?" Why does he put these pairs side by side?

answers.text: They are opposites that don't mix
They work best as a team
They are two names for one thing

cards.text: Paul keeps the questions coming: what harmony is there between Christ and Belial, and what does a believer have in common with an unbeliever? Then one more: what agreement can exist between the temple of God and idols?

cards.question: After all those questions, Paul makes a statement. What does he say is the temple of the living God?

cards.text: WE are the temple, friend, and that's like showing up to work and your name badge says HEADQUARTERS. Then Paul backs it up with what God has said, in words that echo Leviticus 26:11-12.

cards.question: True or false: in the words Paul quotes, God promises to dwell with His people and walk among them.

cards.text: God's words keep going: "I will be their God, and they will be My people." Then Paul quotes the Lord again, in words that echo Isaiah 52:11, and this line starts with "Therefore."

cards.question: Paul quotes the Lord again, and this line starts with "Therefore." What does the Lord call His people to do?

answers.text: Come out from among them and be separate
Stay among them and be their light
Go up to My temple and be cleansed

cards.question: In the same line, the Lord says, "Touch no unclean thing." True or false: He then says He will turn His people away.

cards.text: Then Paul quotes the Lord Almighty one more time, and this one's a promise you stick on the fridge with every magnet you own.

cards.question: What does the Lord Almighty say He will be to His people?

cards.text: And His people will be His sons and daughters, in words that echo 2 Samuel 7:14. So Paul wraps it up and calls them beloved: since we have these promises, let's cleanse ourselves from everything that defiles body and spirit, and friend, that's not a quick wipe of the counter, that's the WHOLE kitchen.

cards.question: Paul says that as we cleanse ourselves, we're perfecting ___ in the fear of God.
